'''''Noshow''''' was a group of 16 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s that originally belonged to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] but were stolen by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].

==History==
Originally in the Rebel Alliance, the Empire stole the shuttles and brought them to an abandoned and forgotten [[Asteroid Hangar]] ''[[Iron Mine]]'' in the [[Talcim Cluster/Legends|Talcim Cluster]]. They planned to use the shuttles to unleash biological warfare operations on Rebel sympathetic worlds as part of a frame up against the Alliance. However, the plan was complicated by a Rebel strike force consisting of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] on a hit and run strike against the facility. ''Noshow'' was launched with [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] as fighter escort as a result and the Rebels changed priorities to destroying the shuttles as they inspected the shuttles and realized their intentions not wishing to let even one escape. [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] were also dispatched as they attacked the Rebel fighters from behind.

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome depends on which side the player takes.
